title: Vision Zero.
bodyText: The department of transportation and the county transportation departments shall adopt a Vision Zero policy that seeks to prevent and ultimately eliminate all traffic fatalities through a combination of engineering, enforcement, education, and emergency response strategies that focus on equity.

bodyHtml:
[§286-7.5]  Vision Zero.  The department of transportation and the county transportation departments shall adopt a Vision Zero policy that seeks to prevent and ultimately eliminate all traffic fatalities through a combination of engineering, enforcement, education, and emergency response strategies that focus on equity. [L 2019, c 134, §2]

 

Note

 

  Section applies to any development for which planning and design commences on or after January 1, 2020.  L 2019, c 134, §5.

  Action plan to reduce traffic fatalities to zero; reports to 2020-2021 legislature.  L 2019, c 134, §3.
